summary: PlanStepPolicyAdapter is implemented as security_execution::policy_adapter. It translates generic AgentCore PlanStep values through ToolRouter, delegates authoritative risk and approval decisions to PolicyEvaluator, records PolicyEvaluated audit events, returns allowed/denied/awaiting-approval outcomes, issues CapabilityLease only for allowed decisions, and never prepares effects on denied or paused paths.

acceptance.criterion: Planner risk hints cannot downgrade policy risk.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::policy_adapter::tests::planner_risk_hints_cannot_downgrade_policy_risk marks svc.restart as ReadOnly in planner hints, but ToolRouter/PolicyEvaluator classify it as execute-with-confirmation and return AwaitingApproval.

acceptance.criterion: Unknown tools and shell.exec are denied before effect preparation.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::policy_adapter::tests::shell_exec_and_unknown_tools_are_denied_before_effect_preparation denies both route failures, emits PolicyEvaluated, and confirms no EffectPrepared.

acceptance.criterion: Paused steps return AwaitingApproval without EffectPrepared.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::policy_adapter::tests::paused_steps_return_awaiting_approval_without_lease_or_effect returns AwaitingApproval, no lease, and only PolicyEvaluated audit.
security_execution::policy_adapter::tests::approval_parameter_mutation_is_paused_not_allowed reuses an nginx approval token for apache and receives AwaitingApproval with no lease.

acceptance.criterion: Allowed steps receive lease metadata suitable for sandbox compilation and audit.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::policy_adapter::tests::allowed_read_only_step_receives_sandbox_ready_lease_and_audit_metadata confirms lease tool/resource/parameter_hash/policy_version/risk and matching PolicyEvaluated audit metadata.

policy_adapter_contract.side_effect_path: none; adapter records policy decisions only and never emits EffectPrepared
